item.text: The product page currently waits for both product and related data before returning anything. I’m changing it to render the shop frame immediately, cache product data by slug and currency, and put related products behind their own streaming boundary.

item.text:
Enabled Cache Components and Partial Prefetching in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts:3). Product details are cached for days with both slug and currency in the cache key, so currency queries retain their correct prices. The product page keeps the shop frame visible while details load, then streams related products separately in [page.tsx](/workspace/app/products/[slug]/page.tsx:20).

`npm run build` passed. Next reported the product routes as partially prerendered with dynamic server-streamed content; no route opt-outs were added.
